annotations.title: Cursor Auto vs pinned model cost

description: Estimate Cursor Auto blended cost versus pinning a single model. Every argument is optional: missing ones use defaults (40 requests/day, 2000 input and 500 output tokens, 22 work days, a 50/30/20 mix of composer-2.5, opus-5 and fable-5, pinned to composer-2.5) and the reply says what it assumed. Model ids: composer-2.5, opus-5, fable-5. Bad input returns a usage hint, not an error. Fits questions like: Is Cursor Auto cheaper than pinning one model? What will my Cursor bill be next month?

autoModelMix.description: Map of model id (composer-2.5, opus-5, fable-5) to weight. Weights are normalized to sum to 1. Default 50/30/20.

pinnedModelId.description: Model to compare against: composer-2.5, opus-5 or fable-5. Default composer-2.5.
